title: trachelospermum inflatum
intro: Trachelospermum inflatum, commonly known as the Chinese jasmine or Chinese star jasmine, is a flowering plant species native to China. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Trachelospermum inflatum include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, making it useful in treating conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
